scriptLines: source1 derive(FechaServicio = iif(regexMatch(trim(FechaServicio), '^[0-9]{5}$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(trim(FechaServicio))), iif(regexMatch(trim(FechaServicio), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(FechaServicio), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(FechaServicio), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))),

derivedColumn1 derive(RutaHistoricaId = iif(startsWith(iifNull(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), ''), 'RH-'), upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), case(codRuta == 'R-07' && FechaServicio <= toDate('2021-12-31'), 'RH-07-OLD', codRuta == 'R-07', 'RH-07-NEW', codRuta == 'R-12' && FechaServicio <= toDate('2022-12-31'), 'RH-12-OLD', codRuta == 'R12-N', 'RH-12-N', codRuta == 'R12-S', 'RH-12-S', concat('RH-', right(codRuta, 2)))),

ParadaHistoricaId = case(upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId)) == 'MC-01' && FechaServicio <= toDate('2023-06-30'), 'P220-MC-OLD', upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId)) == 'MC-01', 'P220-MC-NEW', upper(trim(ParadaHistoricaId))),

derivedColumn2 derive(DemandaId = iif(length(iifNull(trim(DemandaId), '')) > 0, trim(DemandaId), concat('DM-', toString(AnioFuente), '-', left(md5(toString(FechaServicio, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), RutaHistoricaId, ParadaHistoricaId, Franja), 12)))) ~> derivedColumn3
EsPrincipal = iif(upper(trim(EsPrincipal)) == '1' || upper(trim(EsPrincipal)) == 'TRUE', true(), false())) ~> derivedColumn1
VehiculoId = iif(length(iifNull(trim(VehiculoId), '')) == 0, toString(null()), concat('V-', lpad(regexExtract(trim(VehiculoId), '([0-9]+)', 1), 3, '0')))) ~> derivedColumn1

derivedColumn1 derive(inicio_f = iif(regexMatch(trim(inicio_f), '^[0-9]{5}$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(trim(inicio_f))), iif(regexMatch(trim(inicio_f), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(inicio_f), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(inicio_f), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))),

fin_f = iif(regexMatch(trim(fin_f), '^[0-9]{5}$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(trim(fin_f))), iif(regexMatch(trim(fin_f), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(fin_f), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(fin_f), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd'))),

reg_f = iif(regexMatch(trim(reg_f), '^[0-9]{5}$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(trim(reg_f))), iif(regexMatch(trim(reg_f), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(trim(reg_f), 'dd/MM/yyyy'), toDate(left(trim(reg_f), 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd')))) ~> derivedColumn2
